verdict.rationale: Navan documents its own machine-to-machine API: an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow with retrieval and update endpoints across expenses, plus async job-status polling and webhooks. That supports unattended, headless programmatic automation of the service. It ships no CLI, CI integration, or documented headless/CI runner, so 'run in CI' is only achievable by scripting against the API yourself. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI tooling, documented headless/CI usage guides or examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of automated pipelines.
